value.name: send wire to Bridgepoint account
value.description: A wire transfer is sent to the Bridgepoint account before five, completing a crucial financial action.
evidence: it wired to the Bridgepoint account before five.

value.name: Asha gives routing numbers
value.description: Asha slowly reads the routing numbers to Marcus, then falls silent to let silence do the work.
evidence: She gave him the routing numbers slowly, the way she would read them to a client, and then stopped talking, because she had learned in the last hour that her silence did more work than her sentences.

value.name: Marcus acknowledges Lucia and confirms he is at laptop
value.description: Marcus quietly says Lucia's name and tells Asha he is at his laptop, signaling his involvement in the transfer.
evidence: On the other end Marcus said Lucia's name once, quietly, as though placing it where it belonged, and then said he was at his laptop.

value.name: Rosa drives to Lucia's address
value.description: Rosa is already on the expressway with Lucia's address on the dash, heading toward Lucia.
evidence: Across the city, Rosa was already on the expressway with Lucia's address pulled up on the dash,

value.name: Rosa gets building number from Daniel
value.description: Rosa calls Daniel for Lucia's building number, takes it down, and ends the call before he can add conditions.
evidence: and she called Daniel for the building number without saying hello, took it down, and hung up before he could attach a condition to it.

value.name: Asha receives wire confirmation
value.description: Asha hears the confirmation email arrive, confirming the transfer while she sits with her father.
evidence: By the time Asha heard the soft chime of a confirmation arriving in her email, the dim room around her father had narrowed to the rise of his breath and the screen in her lap,

value.name: Asha calls supervisor about discharge paperwork
value.description: Asha immediately calls the supervisor and demands discharge and medication paperwork for Bridgepoint within the hour.
evidence: With the confirmation still glowing on her screen, Asha thumbed back to the supervisor's number and pressed call before the woman had time to forward it elsewhere.

When the line picked up she said the wire had cleared, that she expected the attending's discharge order and the medication reconciliation in her inbox within the hour, and named Bridgepoint by full address so it could not later be transcribed as somewhere else.

value.name: Asha silences supervisor's paperwork objection
value.description: When the supervisor starts to mention state-bed paperwork, Asha lets the objection hang until the woman stops speaking.
evidence: The supervisor began to mention the state-bed paperwork already drafted, and Asha let the half-sentence sit on the line until the woman heard it herself and stopped.
